compute_class_likelihood_ratios: compute positive and negative class likelihood ratios to assess binary classifier predictive power
cross_validate_likelihood_ratios: cross-validate a classifier using positive and negative likelihood ratios as scoring metrics
evaluate_dummy_classifier: evaluate a dummy classifier with stratified strategy using likelihood ratio scoring
bootstrap_likelihood_ratios: bootstrap likelihood ratio estimates across varying class prevalence levels
plot_likelihood_ratios_prevalence: plot positive and negative likelihood ratios as a function of class prevalence
